title: Place a level-based air terminal at a point
task: Place an air terminal at a point on a level with doc.Create.NewFamilyInstance, choosing an OST_DuctTerminal family symbol whose FamilyPlacementType is level- or work-plane-based so it needs no host face. Covers placing MEP fixtures.

pitfalls.symptom: NewFamilyInstance throws or the air terminal does not place, complaining it needs a host.
pitfalls.cause: Many air terminal families are face-based (hosted on a ceiling or a duct face) and cannot be placed at a bare point.
pitfalls.fix: Filter the OST_DuctTerminal FamilySymbols for Family.FamilyPlacementType OneLevelBased or WorkPlaneBased before placing, and activate the symbol first.

pitfalls.symptom: A task search 'place an air terminal at a point on a level' does not surface the placement member; top hits are FamilyInstance.HostParameter and other properties.
pitfalls.cause: Autodesk.Revit.Creation.*.NewFamilyInstance ranks poorly for placement intent (connector issue #341).
pitfalls.fix: Search naming the member (e.g. 'NewFamilyInstance place a family instance at a point with a level'); place with the XYZ/FamilySymbol/Level overload.

miss.text: place an air terminal family instance at a point on a level
